timeline.summary: PB Fintech’s Board, led by Chairman & Group CEO Yashish Dahiya, will hold an earnings call on May 06, 2026, at 06:00 PM (IST) post Q4 FY 2025-26 results.
Paisabazaar received a CIT(A) order confirming tax disallowances of ₹145.91 Cr for FY22 and FY23, with appeals to be filed.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,061.33 Cr, net profit ₹261.16 Cr.
PB Fintech Limited uploaded the audio recording of its Q4 FY26 earnings conference call on May 6, 2026, via its website.
PB Fintech subsidiary PB Marketing and Consulting received SEBI registration to act as a Stock Broker in the Debt Segment on NSE.
The board approved the re-appointment of two independent directors and the appointment of Jyotsana Vempati Aggarwal as a new independent director.
PB Fintech held Analyst Day 2026, setting a FY30 target of ₹1 Lakh Cr insurance premium and reaffirming ₹1,000 Cr PAT target for FY27.
PB Fintech discussed Q4FY26 performance in its earnings call, reporting FY26 premium of ₹29,934 Cr and renewal ARR of ₹1,126 Cr.

On 24 September 2026, PB Fintech held an analyst call to discuss a draft IRDAI consultation paper on insurance commissions, saying general insurance revenue could fall to one-third to 40% of current levels but FY27 would be unaffected.
PB Fintech Limited will hold its earnings conference call for shareholders, investors and analyst on Friday, October 30, 2026, at 06:00 P.M. (IST).

Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,177.71 Cr (+35.0% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹192.45 Cr (+42.7% YoY) (includes ₹4.49 Cr from discontinued operations; continuing operations ₹196.88 Cr).
